evidence_status: proposed accepted-parent synthetic numerical-verification design; not implemented or executed
claim_boundary: The future result would be controlled synthetic numerical verification, not material validation, scientific validation, uncertainty quantification, or a theorem.
Parent reconstruction, represented-gauge error, model-class residual, symmetry covariance, and schedule dependence remain separate diagnostics.
The isotropic and anisotropic parent cases remain distinct represented model spaces; an axis swap maps the anisotropic case to a separately identified swapped parent.
The gauge bridge is an equivalence relation, not a third independent estimate or vote.
No route, schedule, orientation, or model class may be selected or averaged to obtain a favorable outcome.
This design authorizes no implementation, accepted-parent read by new Stage C code, calculation, Stage D work, publication, release, deposit, or external transmission.

represented_space.dense_matrix_disposition: reconstruct from compact parent hoppings, defect terms, transformations, and twist metadata; do not duplicate dense matrices in retained JSON

parent_cases.source: stage-b-result.json input_hoppings selected from the accepted periodic coupling_continuation entry lambda_xy=0
accepted periodic input anisotropic_control and result anisotropy_control
parent_cases.compact_hopping_construction: deterministically reconstruct the separable lowest-band hopping inventory on the accepted 15x15 reciprocal mesh at plane-wave cutoff 5, retain only squared radius at most 18, and preserve the full pretruncation-to-truncation residual separately
parent_cases.axis_swap_rule: construct the target only by swapping x and y in the retained anisotropic hopping inventory and identify it as a distinct parent representation

matrix_routes.construction: construct parent and localized defect matrices directly in the centered uniform-link gauge from compact inputs and the unreduced twist lift
construct parent and localized defect matrices independently in the quotient seam gauge from compact inputs and the componentwise reduced twist

gauge_bridge.rule: H_B(phi mod 1) = W(phi) H_A(phi) W(phi)^dagger for parent, defect, and attacked candidate matrices

known_alignment_attack.route_local_rule: each route constructs its own parent, defect, attacked candidate, inverse alignment, subtraction, and model fits without consuming another route's matrices or diagnostics

fit_contract.method: real least squares over stacked real and imaginary entries after route-local inverse alignment and energy correction
fit_contract.residual_operand_order: represented recovered defect minus fitted model
fit_contract.selection: first class in frozen order satisfying the maximum-entry, Frobenius, shell, and exact-support criteria
forbidden: changing class order or tolerance after observing outcomes
combining model residual with parent reconstruction or representation error
fit_contract.selection_input_boundary: the selector receives only the aligned recovered defect, frozen ordered bases, and tolerances; expected planted class identity is evaluated only after selection

symmetry_and_axis_swap_contract.isotropic: full-Hamiltonian and recovered-defect covariance under all eight D4 operations at the route-appropriate transformed twist
symmetry_and_axis_swap_contract.anisotropic: full-Hamiltonian and recovered-defect covariance only under identity, half turn, reflection x, and reflection y
symmetry_and_axis_swap_contract.axis_swap: reflection_diagonal maps the lambda_x=0.3, lambda_y=0.7 parent, twist, and oriented defect to the separately identified lambda_x=0.7, lambda_y=0.3 parent
symmetry_and_axis_swap_contract.forbidden: do not claim C4 or diagonal-reflection invariance for one anisotropic parent
symmetry_and_axis_swap_contract.axis_swap_coset: reflection_diagonal is the single frozen D4/D2 coset representative; reflection_antidiagonal equals a retained D2 half turn composed with that representative and is not a second independent axis-swap case

locality_contract.shell_definition: maximum periodic Chebyshev distance of either matrix index from the aligned defect origin
locality_contract.radius_two_exterior_requirement: at most the algebraic tolerance after exact represented recovery

schedule_order: A_then_B in a fresh spawned process
B_then_A in a fresh spawned process
case_inventory.ordering: isotropic D4 cases, anisotropic D2 cases, axis-swap cases; within each block defect, twist, operation, route; canonical serialization remains schedule independent
case_inventory.schedule_parent_preprocessing: each fresh schedule process independently reconstructs the anisotropic hopping inventory from immutable accepted inputs; hopping digests and preprocessing residuals must agree exactly across schedules

adverse_controls.expected: fail implementation-independence gate before execution authorization

criteria.criterion_failure_disposition: retain FAIL with route, parent, case, twist, operation, class, and schedule identity; do not rank or select a favorable record

anisotropic_parent_preprocessing.purpose: construct the compact anisotropic parent required by the accepted Stage C control without changing accepted physical parameters
retained_outputs: complete pretruncation Fourier coefficient inventory on the 15x15 mesh
truncation maximum-entry and Frobenius residuals at both twists
anisotropic_parent_preprocessing.interpretation: preprocessing and hopping truncation errors remain separate from defect-model residuals and do not revalidate the accepted periodic parent

independent_verification_contract.isotropic_parent_route: reconstruct directly from the 61 retained Stage B hopping records and independently parsed metadata
independent_verification_contract.anisotropic_parent_route: recompute separable one-dimensional Bloch energies from accepted lambda_x and lambda_y at cutoff 5, perform an independent explicit Fourier sum on the 15x15 mesh, and apply the radius-18 mask independently
independent_verification_contract.defect_route: assign every localized bond and Hermitian reverse directly from compact terms in each gauge
independent_verification_contract.fit_oracle: solve the declared real least-squares problem through direct orthogonal projections where the frozen basis is orthogonal and through an independent QR factorization otherwise; normal equations are forbidden
required_reconstruction: known inverse alignment and energy correction
all 1040 class fits and first-passing identities
independent_verification_contract.reconstruction_disposition: independent agreement cannot convert a reproduced numerical criterion failure into a pass

result_contract.format: one closed Draft 2020-12 compact JSON result plus independent verification log, deterministic retained-data SVG, report, manifest, and SHA-256 catalog
required_provenance: design, runner, verifier, plotter, schema, and manifest identities
accepted periodic input and result identities
accepted Stage A, Stage B, and execution-free Stage C identities
exact execution checkpoint and verbatim human response
repository root, Python and NumPy versions, resource envelope, runtime, peak memory, and output bytes
